properties.Location: Model Town / Kachahry Road Central Neighbourhood

properties.Location: Eidgah Road / Old City High-Density Core

properties.Location: Rasinwal / Northern Circular Road Convergence Zone

properties.Location: Zafarwal Road / SW Bypass Drainage Corridor
